8.1.4 Handle Classes
This section contains the definition of the handle classes used in the API of the
Per-
sistency
. The
ara::per::SharedHandle
(templated via
typenameT
) is used to
provide shared access to either a
ara::per::KeyValueStorage
or a
ara::per::
FileStorage
, while the
ara::per::UniqueHandle
(templated via
typenameT
)
is used to provide non-shared access to either a
ara::per::ReadAccessor
or a
ara::per::ReadWriteAccessor
to a
File Storage
.
